E-commerce fulfillment pilot

Make Etsy orders ready for fulfillment.

Fulfillment Workspace is a pilot tool being developed for our shop and other Etsy sellers who choose to connect their shops. It is intended to help operators review orders, validate product and artwork information, and prepare fulfillment data for BurgerPrints.

In development · Etsy API access pending

How it is intended to work

Each seller chooses to connect

A seller will grant access to their own shop through Etsy authorization. Order data from different shops will be kept separate. The initial pilot keeps an operator in control of order review and supplier submission.

01 · ETSY

Read authorized orders

Retrieve only the order and transaction details needed to understand fulfillment requirements.

02 · VALIDATE

Check before sending

Flag missing or mismatched product, variation, shipping and artwork information for an operator.

03 · SUPPLIER

Prepare BurgerPrints data

Create a reviewed supplier output and record whether the operator submitted it successfully.

Current scope

One supplier pilot, more than one shop

The first planned fulfillment path is Etsy to BurgerPrints. We plan to validate it with our shop, then with consenting sellers as permitted by Etsy's app approval. Live Etsy connection, order import, and supplier submission are not active on this site.

PurposeOrder review and fulfillment preparation
Pilot supplierBurgerPrints
AudienceOur shop and other sellers who authorize access
StatusPrototype and API registration preparation

This page introduces the planned application for developer registration and review. It does not accept orders, collect account credentials, or connect visitors to Etsy.
